import pandas as pd
import csv

# Read the input data
input_path = 'outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv'
output_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'

df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Get unique indicator_ids for column ordering
indicator_ids = sorted(df['indicator_id'].unique())

# Pivot the data to wide format
# index: city_id, city_name, year
# columns: indicator_id
# values: value
pivot_df = df.pivot_table(
    index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'],
    columns='indicator_id',
    values='value',
    aggfunc='first'
)

# Reset index to make city_id, city_name, year as regular columns
pivot_df = pivot_df.reset_index()

# Reorder columns: identifier columns first, then indicator columns in sorted order
column_order = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + indicator_ids
pivot_df = pivot_df[column_order]

# Write to CSV with RFC 4180 compliance
# pandas to_csv with default settings handles RFC 4180 quoting (quotes fields with commas, quotes, newlines)
pivot_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
